Flex

Flexbox utility classes for one-dimensional layout — aligning and distributing space among items in a container.

Basic Flex

Use .zak-flex to create a flex container. Children become flex items in a row by default.

Item 1
Item 2
Item 3
HTML
<div class="zak-flex" style="gap: 1rem;">
  <div>Item 1</div>
  <div>Item 2</div>
  <div>Item 3</div>
</div>

Wrap

Use .zak-flex-wrap to allow items to wrap onto multiple lines, or .zak-flex-nowrap to keep them on one line.

CSS Reference

HTML
.zak-flex { display: flex; }
.zak-flex-row { flex-direction: row; }
.zak-flex-column { flex-direction: column; }
.zak-flex-wrap { flex-wrap: wrap; }
.zak-flex-nowrap { flex-wrap: nowrap; }
.zak-flex-fill { flex: 1 1 0%; }
.zak-flex-grow-1 { flex-grow: 1; }
.zak-flex-shrink-0 { flex-shrink: 0; }
.zak-justify-start { justify-content: flex-start; }
.zak-justify-center { justify-content: center; }
.zak-justify-end { justify-content: flex-end; }
.zak-justify-between { justify-content: space-between; }
.zak-justify-around { justify-content: space-around; }
.zak-justify-evenly { justify-content: space-evenly; }
.zak-align-start { align-items: flex-start; }
.zak-align-center { align-items: center; }
.zak-align-end { align-items: flex-end; }
.zak-align-stretch { align-items: stretch; }
.zak-gap-sm { gap: 0.5rem; }
.zak-gap-md { gap: 1rem; }
.zak-gap-lg { gap: 1.5rem; }

Accessibility

  • Flex layout maintains DOM order for screen readers regardless of visual arrangement
  • Avoid using order property to visually reorder items as it disconnects from reading order
  • Ensure flex containers don't break keyboard navigation — test with Tab key
